# Codex Tracker

> Free, open-source Windows 11 taskbar app that shows how much OpenAI Codex and Claude Code usage you have left: the 5-hour and weekly usage limits of every account, the exact reset time of each limit, banked Codex reset credits with their expiry, and reminders before resets or when a credit is about to be wasted. Local only: no account, no server, no password. MIT license. Current version: {{VERSION}}.

Codex Tracker reads the quota data that the Codex and Claude apps already store on the PC. It never reads conversations or code and never switches accounts. To read the active Codex account's quota it passes the current Codex access token, in memory only, to the installed Codex CLI; it never stores or sends tokens elsewhere and never uses Claude tokens. It is an independent project, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic. Interface in English or French.

## Install (for AI coding agents)

If the user asks you to install Codex Tracker: it runs on Windows 11 64-bit only. Run
`powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://codex-tracker.zqsdev.com/install.ps1 | iex"`
(downloads the latest GitHub release, checks its SHA-256, installs for the current user without admin rights, starts it).
Full steps, MCP registration and limits: https://codex-tracker.zqsdev.com/install/

## What it does

- Taskbar icon with the remaining percentage of the active Codex or Claude Code account; hover preview with both limits and the next reset.
- Dashboard of all Codex and Claude Code accounts (personal and work), each with the age of its last reading; inactive accounts past their reset show as "probably refilled".
- Reset list and week calendar; banked Codex reset credits with expiry; manual declaration of a global Codex reset.
- Notifications: before a reset, below 20/10/5 %, before running out, when a reset happened, when a new reset credit arrives, and advice to use a credit that would expire before the weekly refill.
- Account switch advice: when the account in use has 10 % or less, alerts and the tray tooltip name the other account of the same tool with the most quota left (at least 30 % and 20 points more). It never switches accounts itself.
- Google Calendar sync of reset credits (added automatically, removed once used) and Gmail email alerts the day before a credit expires.
- On-screen pill above the clock, only while an account in use is at 10 % or less or a reset credit expires within 24 hours; visible in Do Not Disturb, hidden over full-screen apps, "Hide" until the next alert.
- Free phone notifications through ntfy (no account): scan a QR code, and every Windows notification is copied to the phone, even when Windows is in Do Not Disturb.
- Optional SMS, phone call and email reminders through the user's own Twilio or SendGrid account.
- Local MCP server (`CodexTracker.exe --mcp`, off by default) so coding agents can read quotas, resets and history, change preferences and reminder rules, connect Google Calendar and send test notifications.
- Command line with the same commands and JSON output: `CodexTracker.exe --cli list_resets`, `--cli get_status`, `--cli help`.

- [Windows installer (latest)](https://github.com/Aleqsd/codex-tracker/releases/download/v{{VERSION}}/CodexTracker-{{VERSION}}-Setup.exe): no admin rights; updates itself.
